name: Doxylamine
effects: Potent sedation and hypnosis — primary OTC sleep aid use
Antiemetic — used for pregnancy-related nausea (with pyridoxine)
Anticholinergic: dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision
At doses >150 mg: disorientation, visual hallucinations, delirium
At doses >300 mg: anticholinergic toxidrome, tachycardia, hyperthermia — life-threatening
sources: Diclegis (doxylamine succinate and pyridoxine hydrochloride) label; https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=8bde08f6-e8bd-4e90-baa7-82e01876a86a
